description: This file defines API endpoints for user authentication, including sign-up, email verification, sign-in, and password reset functionalities, using FastAPI framework. It imports models, dependencies, and services, and sets up a router with several POST endpoints.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API routes for authentication endpoints.

methods.name: SignUpResponse signup( payload: SignUpRequest, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Creates a new user via Supabase and sends email verification code.

methods.name: None send_verification_code( payload: SendVerificationCodeRequest, email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Sends or re-sends email verification code.

methods.name: None verify_code(payload: VerifyCodeRequest)
methods.description: Verifies email with a code sent to user's email.

methods.name: AuthTokenResponse signin(payload: SignInRequest)
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.

methods.name: None forgot_password(payload: ForgotPasswordRequest)
methods.description: Initiates password reset by sending a code to email.

methods.name: None reset_password(payload: ResetPasswordRequest)
methods.description: Resets user's password using a verification code.

ctags.name: send_verification_code
ctags.signature: ( payload: SendVerificationCodeRequest, email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )

ctags.name: signup
ctags.signature: ( payload: SignUpRequest, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
